facts: Apple and pear seeds contain arsenic, which may be deadly to dogs.
There is a dog-shaped building in New Zealand.
Flyball, a dog sport consisting of relays, hurdles, and ball retrieving, was developed in the late 60s, and the first tournament was held in 1983.
The world's largest dog was a Great Dane named Zorba, who weighed 343 pounds.
A dog's nose is the equivalent of a human's fingerprints, as no two dogs have the same nose print.
